title: Note-required option on checkbox and per-axle fields, on by default
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Settings — Service.
  2. You are editing a template with a checkbox field and a per-axle field.
custom_steps:
1. Add a new checkbox field and open its authoring options.
  2. Add a per-axle field and open its options.
custom_expected:
1. A checkbox field offers an authoring option "Note required if Monitor / Not OK".
  2. The option is on by default for newly added checkbox fields.
  3. The same option applies to per-axle measurement fields.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8181 and story SV-9099 (S1, Require a note on flagged responses) and the Digital Inspections V2 specification version 18, sections S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R6, read on 21 August 2026.
